name: conditional-fields
title: Conditional fields
description: A checkbox, switch or radio that reveals its own fields when chosen: the reveal is announced, and hidden fields are inert and left out of the submit.
docs: Put the fields inside; they open beneath the control when it is on. trigger is checkbox (the default), switch or radio. A checkbox or switch can keep its own state (defaultChecked) or be controlled (checked and onCheckedChange). A radio sits inside your RadioGroup and gets checked={value === "its value"}, because the group owns the choice. The control carries aria-controls (and aria-expanded on a checkbox or switch, the roles that may have it), and a polite status says that fields appeared or went. Closed, the fields are inert and in a disabled fieldset: Tab skips them, a screen reader does not find them and the form does not send them. keepValues (default true) keeps what was typed while the panel is shut; false removes the fields after the fold, so uncontrolled inputs start over. Focus never moves into the panel by itself. Each panel is a fieldset named by the label, so a ConditionalFields inside another one is a nested level.
